speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance whether the Majulah Package for Singaporeans can be modified to include items for which only age, and not housing type and income, form the eligibility criteria.

speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui
text: asked the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance whether the Majulah Package can be amended to encompass elements where sole age-based qualifications are applicable, excluding considerations of housing category and income.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Nevertheless, we recognise that there may be concerns that are common to all Singaporeans within this group.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I want to thank the Senior Minister of State for his reply.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: The Majulah Package as it was announced at first, sounds like it is going to be means tested.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I understand that you may not be able to design it totally like the previous packages, but I thought that we could learn more from the lessons from the design of these two earlier packages, for consideration.
